stories.title: What we know about the deadly flooding on the Nepal-Tibet border
stories.summary: Nearly 100 people are dead, and many more are missing, after an avalanche of ice and rock blocked a Himalayan river valley, triggering massive flash floods in Nepal.

stories.title: Trump touts power of his endorsement following South Sen. Darline Graham's primary win
stories.summary: Darline Graham won her primary runoff in the race to replace her late brother in the US Senate. And President Trump can again tout the power of his endorsement.

stories.title: Why many Black Americans feel a special kinship with Dolly Parton
stories.summary: The late superstar Dolly Parton had an incredible legacy in American culture. That was even true from a Black American viewpoint. The Black Wall Street Times' Nehemiah Frank describes Parton's impact.

stories.title: Meta settlement means new restrictions on nighttime and school-time scrolling for kids
stories.summary: Can the changes to Facebook and Instagram announced in the Meta settlement make a difference for the mental health of young people?

stories.title: Amid rising threats, a WNBA team calls in experts on violent extremism
stories.summary: The WNBA's popularity has risen in recent years, but so have threats and abuse directed at its players. One team is taking a novel approach to this, by partnering with national security specialists.

stories.title: In Louisiana, NDAs covered up a data center deal that residents didn't know was coming
stories.summary: Residents of tiny Boyce, La., yelled at local officials for signing agreements that hid a pending deal for a data center. NDAs, common in Louisiana data center deals, are coming under more scrutiny.
